answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments to validate the detection robustness and quality of SEMSTAMP on the RealNews subset of the C4 dataset, BookSum, and Reddit-TIFU ...

answer_2.quote: Metrics We use binary classification metrics: (1) area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and (2) the true positive rate when the false positive rate is 1% or 5% (TP@1%, TP@5%). To evaluate generation quality, we measure the perplexity (PPL) with OPT-2.7B. Generation diversity is measured with trigram text entropy (Ent-3) ... We also evaluate generations with Sem-Ent ... We evaluate the quality of paraphrases using BERTScore.
